title: Jev for Scientific Decisions: Evaluating Semantic Choices and Their Consequences
titleZh: Jev 在科学决策中的应用：语义选择及其后果评估
summaryEn: Studies Jev in a scientific-workflow setting by separating semantic choice, downstream computation, and final conclusions; it argues that a correct label does not by itself establish a correct relation or quantity.
summaryZh: 把 Jev 放在科学工作流的语义选择环节，单独检查语义选择、下游计算与最终结论，强调标签正确不等于关系和数量都正确。
evidenceNote: arXiv 一手记录明确给出 Jev、实验配置、数据集与限制；代码链接仍需后续补核。

title: Visual Jev: Accurate and Efficient Decisions from Shared Visual Context
titleZh: Visual Jev：共享视觉上下文下的准确高效决策
summaryEn: Presents a visual decision system built around shared image context, batched question suffixes, and probabilistic candidate outputs; the paper describes it as inspired by Jev rather than as a call to the official service.
summaryZh: 研究共享图像上下文、批量问题后缀与候选概率读出的视觉决策系统；页面将其标为受 Jev 思路启发，而非官方 Jev 服务调用。
evidenceNote: arXiv 一手记录给出系统定义、基准结果与代码入口；与 TypeSafe 官方 Jev 的关系按论文自述保守标注。

title: Replacing Large Language Models with Jev Decision Models for Low-Latency Edge Service Orchestration
titleZh: 用 Jev 决策模型替代大语言模型进行低延迟边缘服务编排
paperType: 系统实证 / 延迟评测
summaryEn: Connects bounded-intent Jev decisions to edge-service orchestration and compares latency, completion, and cost against a large-language-model baseline using measured OCR services.
summaryZh: 将 Jev 的有界意图决策接入边缘服务编排，并用在线测量与真实 OCR 服务比较延迟、完成率和费用。
evidenceNote: arXiv 一手摘要明确给出 API 测量、两节点 OCR 服务、比较对象与指标；结果只代表论文测试路径。

title: Jev-Mem: System-One-Controlled Agentic Memory for Efficient AI Agents
titleZh: Jev-Mem：由 System One 控制的高效智能体记忆
summaryEn: Uses a System One control plane to select memory types, route retrieval, allocate budgets, and stop adaptively, while delegating complex reasoning to a System Two component.
summaryZh: 把 System One 控制平面用于记忆类型、检索路由、预算分配和自适应停止，再交给 System Two 做复杂推理。
evidenceNote: arXiv 一手记录给出架构、LoCoMo 结果与延迟指标；项目代码作为独立条目维护。

title: Type-Safe Is Not Error-Free: A Constrained Decision Head Follows the Option Name, Not the Rubric Bound to It
titleZh: 类型安全并非无错误：受约束决策头跟随选项名称，而非与其绑定的评判准则
paperType: 可靠性 / 受约束决策评测
summaryEn: Tests Jev and two open-weight Jev-like models by permuting option names while holding rubrics, questions, and option sets fixed. The study reports large ranking reversals and AUC drops under semantically polarized names, even though outputs remain schema-valid, and finds a neutral-name control removes the effect.
summaryZh: 在固定问题、选项集合和文字准则的条件下，仅置换选项名称，评测 Jev 与两个开放权重的 Jev-like 模型。结果显示，带有语义极性的名称会造成大幅排序反转和 AUC 下降，但输出仍完全符合类型约束；中性名称对照基本消除了这一效应。
evidenceNote: arXiv 一手摘要明确说明实验直接包含 Jev、受约束选项/准则置换、 hosted-model 对照与类型错误率；数值结果是该预印本实验的作者报告。

title: JEV-as-a-Judge: Accept When Confident, Escalate When Unsure
titleZh: JEV-as-a-Judge：有信心时接受，不确定时升级
summaryEn: Evaluates a decision-only Jev judge against sixteen generative and reward-model judges with blinded human adjudication. The reported cascade accepts high-confidence verdicts and escalates uncertain cases, retaining nearly all comparator accuracy at a fraction of the stated fee while exposing gaps on derivation checking and deceptive answers.
summaryZh: 以盲法人工裁决为参照，将只输出决策的 Jev judge 与 16 个生成式或奖励模型 judge 比较。论文报告了一种高置信度直接接受、低置信度升级的级联，在较低费用下保留接近全部对照准确率；对推导核验和精心编写的错误答案仍存在明显差距。
evidenceNote: arXiv 一手摘要明确给出 Jev judge、比较法、人工裁决、置信度级联与适用限制；费用和准确率数字仅代表论文报告的评测设置。

title: REFLEX with Jev for Efficient Selective Control in LLM Agents
titleZh: 使用 Jev 的 REFLEX：面向大语言模型智能体的高效选择性控制
paperType: 系统 / 选择性控制评测
summaryEn: Studies REFLEX, an agent architecture that uses Jev as a fast typed decision layer and invokes a stronger language model when confidence is low or generation is required. On a frozen 100-task benchmark it reports high task success with fewer strong-model calls, while interventions and external evaluations identify action-set and routing limits.
summaryZh: 研究 REFLEX 智能体架构：把 Jev 用作快速类型化决策层，在置信度低或需要生成时再调用强语言模型。在固定的 100 任务基准上，论文报告以更少的强模型调用保持较高成功率；干预实验和外部评测也揭示了动作集合大小及路由场景的限制。
evidenceNote: arXiv 一手摘要明确将 Jev 作为 typed decision layer，并给出冻结基准、回退族和外部评测；效果与局限均是该预印本作者报告。

title: JEVQA - Video Quality from Metadata, Bitstream, and Pixel Features with a General-Purpose Decision Model
titleZh: JEVQA：利用元数据、比特流和像素特征与通用决策模型评估视频质量
paperType: 应用实证 / 视频质量
summaryEn: Evaluates Jev as a zero-shot video-quality model using metadata, bitstream statistics, and pixel-derived features. Across two encode collections, the reported correlations improve when bitstream and combined features are supplied, while a pixel-only variant fails and trained models remain ahead.
summaryZh: 把 Jev 作为零样本视频质量模型，分别输入元数据、比特流统计和像素特征进行评估。在两组编码数据上，加入比特流及组合特征后相关性提高；仅像素特征的变体失败，而使用同类特征训练的模型仍然更强。
evidenceNote: arXiv 一手摘要明确称评测对象为商业 Jev System One 模型，并列出 VMAF/MOS 对照、特征变体与限制；相关系数是作者在所用数据集上的报告。

title: Open-Jev Judgments on CallScreenBench: Calibrated One-Pass Scam Screening with a Small Language Model
titleZh: CallScreenBench 上的 Open-Jev 判定：用小语言模型进行校准的单次诈骗筛查
paperType: 开源复现 / 应用评测
summaryEn: Applies an open Jev-style readout, JevLite, to scam-call screening by mapping two answer-label logits from a LoRA-tuned small language model to a calibrated probability. The paper reports held-out CallScreenBench results, earlier decisions, and lower latency, but notes synthetic callers, test-set exposure, and no architectural novelty.
summaryZh: 将开放的 Jev 风格读出实现 JevLite 用于诈骗电话筛查：对 LoRA 微调小语言模型的两个答案标签 logit 做温度缩放，得到诈骗概率。论文报告了 CallScreenBench 留出场景上的区分度、校准、提前决策和延迟结果，同时明确说明来电者为合成数据、存在测试集暴露，且不主张架构创新。
evidenceNote: arXiv 一手摘要明确称其测试的是 open implementation/JevLite 而非官方 hosted Jev；因此关系标为 replica，所有指标限于论文的合成来电和评测流程。

title: this-that-model-1.0: A typed decision model that decides in 30 ms, for a millionth of a cent
titleZh: this-that-model-1.0：30 毫秒内、百万分之一美分完成决策的类型化决策模型
paperType: 替代模型 / 系统评测
summaryEn: Introduces a 2B-parameter local typed-decision model whose answer is read from a designated hidden state and restricted to caller-declared options without text generation. The authors compare it with hosted Jev and frontier calls on recorded decisions and internal suites, and report both speed/cost gains and weaknesses on multi-step arithmetic and transfer.
summaryZh: 提出一个 20 亿参数的本地类型化决策模型：从指定位置的隐藏状态直接读出答案，并限制在调用方声明的选项集合内，不生成文本。作者用记录的决策问题和内部测试套件与 hosted Jev、前沿模型调用比较，同时报告速度/成本优势以及多步算术和跨任务迁移上的弱点。
evidenceNote: arXiv 一手摘要明确将 hosted Jev 作为比较对象，并给出本地开源模型、测量设置和失败边界；其性能数字是作者在指定问题集上的报告，不等同于独立复现。

title: Fast Intent-Driven Service Orchestration with Jev for 6G Edge Networks
titleZh: 面向 6G 边缘网络的 Jev 快速意图驱动服务编排
paperType: 系统实证 / 边缘服务编排
summaryEn: Evaluates Jev for translating changing 6G edge-service requirements into executable contracts before numerical scheduling. The study combines live model responses, packet-level New Radio simulation, mobility and shared queues, plus a real image-reading service, and reports faster decisions with task-completion comparisons against DeepSeek, Gemini, and Qwen.
summaryZh: 评估 Jev 将变化中的 6G 边缘服务需求翻译为可执行合同，再交由数值调度器分配资源。实验结合在线模型响应、分组级新无线电仿真、移动事件、共享队列和真实图像读取服务，并与 DeepSeek、Gemini、Qwen 比较决策延迟和按时完成情况。
evidenceNote: arXiv 一手摘要明确给出 Jev 的合同激活角色、模型对照、仿真/真实服务组合和 12 条轨迹复现检查；性能结果仅适用于论文建模和测试路径。

title: Calibrated Decisions at Scale: Converting Police Crash Narratives into Probabilistic Crash Variables with a System One Model (Jev)
titleZh: 规模化校准决策：使用 System One 模型（Jev）将警察事故叙述转换为概率事故变量
paperType: 应用实证 / 概率标注
summaryEn: Formulates large-scale crash-narrative coding as gated typed decisions answered by Jev, auditing probabilities against coded fields and 2,416 blinded human judgments while comparing two frontier models. The paper reports a 27-question schema over 195,857 coded narratives from a 499,500-narrative screen, with calibration and review-budget analyses.
summaryZh: 把大规模事故叙述编码建模为由 Jev 回答的门控类型化决策，并用既有编码字段和 2,416 条盲法人工判断审计概率，同时与两个前沿模型比较。论文报告了覆盖 499,500 条叙述筛选、195,857 条编码记录的 27 问题模式，并分析校准和人工复核预算。
evidenceNote: arXiv 一手记录明确给出 Jev 的 System One 角色、样本规模、27 问题模式、人工盲评、前沿模型对照及校准限制；F1、校准误差和年度事故数均限于作者报告的交通事故数据与评测设置。
